question: Who is asked to protect us and fulfill our heart’s desire?
premises: Rāma together with Lakṣmaṇa is invoked
He is asked to protect us and fulfill our desire
inference: Rāma accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa grants both protection and fulfillment of wishes
plain_english: May Rāma, together with Lakṣmaṇa, protect us and fulfill our heart’s desire.
